A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 18-page versions of VisualCloze. Their text, equations, Tables 1–3, Figures 1–14, and Appendices A–C support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original quantitative image-generation experiments in Tables 1–3, qualitative in-context learning experiments in Section 5, and the model-adaptation ablation in appendix Figure 14.

after.justification: v3 retains these original quantitative experiments, qualitative demonstrations, and appendix ablation results.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same visual in-context infilling framework, masking procedure, positional embeddings, and LoRA fine-tuning. The FLUX.1-dev adaptation in Appendix B is also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both retain Graph200K, the additional training data in Section 3.3, and the same evaluation coverage, including conditional generation, restoration, subject-driven generation, style transfer, and unseen-task demonstrations.

E2.justification: Comparator participation is unchanged within Tables 1–3: ControlNet, OminiControl, OneDiffusion, and OmniGen retain their respective comparisons, and Table 3 retains InstantStyle [64] and OmniGen. The Oursdev comparison is unchanged.

E3.justification: Sections 4.3 and 5.2 and Appendix C retain the same training budget, image resizing, model configurations, context-count comparisons, and evaluation metrics. No evaluation procedure or previously stated setting is revised.

E4.justification: Both contain the same analyses of context quantity and example selection, the same infilling-versus-text-to-image model comparison, and the same separate-versus-unified mean/shift ablation in appendix Figure 14.

E5.justification: Figure 6 retains three results with different initial noises, and Figure 10 retains its three-trial demonstrations. Tables 1–3 retain the same reporting practice without uncertainty intervals; no seed, run-count, or significance-testing information is added.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–3 and all qualitative examples are retained. For example, Oursfill depth RMSE remains 10.31 with zero contexts and 9.68 with two contexts; its zero-context DINOv2 score remains 80.41.

T1.justification: The graph/path formulation in Section 3.1 and the grid, infilling, and mask definitions in Section 4.2, including Equations 1–2, are unchanged. No formal assumption, derivation, theorem, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning visual in-context learning, Graph200K, compatibility with infilling models, unseen-task generalization, task unification, and reverse generation.

C2.justification: The interpretations of task ambiguity, example selection, and infilling-model advantages are unchanged. Section 6 retains the same limitations concerning object removal, unseen-task instability, and ambiguous demonstrations; Appendix C retains its style-reference-copying caveat.

D1.justification: Section 4.3 and Appendices A–C retain identical hyperparameters, hardware information, instruction formats, model-adaptation details, and metric descriptions. The project-page link and other technical resource links are unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning, and all 88 cited works are retained. No citation or substantive comparison with prior research is added or removed.

P1.justification: v3 adds Qilong Wu to the author list and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Otherwise, the prose, terminology, section order, and appendix organization are unchanged; extraction spacing differences do not represent substantive rewriting.

P2.justification: Figures 1–14 and Tables 1–3 retain the same visual content, captions, panel arrangements, formatting, and placement, including appendix Figures 13–14. The author-text update does not reorganize the page layout.

improvement.justification: v3 retains the same scientific content, empirical evidence, technical documentation, limitations, and visual presentation throughout the main text and appendices. The author-list and version-stamp updates do not establish a meaningful difference in the paper's overall quality.
